questions: Does incorporated authority impose additional conditions beyond these three factors? The supplied clause establishes their necessity; this selected antecedent experiment does not determine their sufficiency for a complete licensing verdict.

assumptions: This predicate concerns the selected applicability condition, not whole-law compliance or licence possession.
Case-dependent input classifications and incorporated authority remain external to the encoded predicate.
The declared input vocabulary is supplied for this controlled comparison; its adequacy as a legal abstraction remains unverified.
The relative phrase “all of which” refers to the three enumerated factors collectively, and “must be present” requires each factor.
All three inputs concern the same family office, services and associated business. Applicable regulated-activity carve-outs have already been resolved in regulated.
True means that all three selected conditions are satisfied; no input truth value is inferred from the text.

citations.quote: The issue of whether a single family office is required to be licensed under the Ordinance is determined by reference to three key factors, all of which must be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation: firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.

readings.distinction: Only one defensible Boolean parse remains within the selected scope. A disjunction would contradict “all”; attachment solely to the third factor would contradict the plural antecedent “three key factors” and the enumeration. “One or more” operates within the first factor, not between the three factors. Reading the factors as necessary conditions rather than an exhaustive sufficient licensing rule is a substantive qualification, but yields the same conjunction for this antecedent experiment. Qualifications concerning business classification affect the supplied inputs rather than changing this connective.

vocabulary_concerns: The supplied Boolean inputs express the conjunction but do not resolve the case-dependent legal classifications, the intra-group carve-out, or the qualified business guidance in Q3. Those matters remain external judgments.

The vocabulary cannot distinguish satisfaction of these three necessary factors from sufficiency under all incorporated authority, nor independently verify that the facts concern the same services and business. The selected scope and stated assumptions preserve those limitations.
